independence: Independent DFTK plane-wave Hamiltonian, SCF, analytic local-pseudopotential and Ewald forces. Libxc XC formulas shared with PySCF; no Gaussian basis or PySCF derivative used.
electrostatics: Native neutral-cell Ewald plus native GTH G=0 correction; no fitted energy or force shifts.

finite_difference.method: Fully re-converged central total-energy differences at fixed lattice, cutoff and kmesh; atom indices zero based, Cartesian component indices zero based.
